_comment: Spike reference — copy to a scratch repo's .vscode/settings.json. Scopes Copilot to .github/ only and suppresses .claude/* skills+rules+hooks so a both-harness repo does not double-register. NOTE: workspace-trust-gated (restricted:true) — applies only after Workspace Trust. Known suppression bugs: microsoft/vscode#297538, #299820 — verify actual load via /skills + the Hooks output channel, do not trust the flags alone.
